payload.title: Host is taken from the Host header and checked against APP_URL
payload.context: Security review of M3 (#16): trusted proxies could set the host of generated links through forwarded headers. Extends ADR 0008.
payload.rationale: Proxies are trusted for client address and scheme only. Trusted hosts are the APP_URL host plus localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1]. The web port binds to loopback by default.
payload.consequences: A reverse proxy must pass the original Host header and APP_URL must match the public address, or requests get 400.
